text:
maya: Heads up — invoice run for Neptune Health (cust_9982) created a duplicate and is missing the 'Partner Support - 10%' line. PDF shows $12,345 but expected $13,679 (includes support). Job id: bill-run-2026-03-23-47, batch 7. @billing-team @anita :eyes:

billing-bot: automated retry launched for failed PDFs, created invoice inv_224501A and inv_224501B (duplicate).

liam: I can confirm both invoices exist in DB. inv_224501B has the support_line_id NULL/omitted. Looks like the support line never attached.

anita: grabbing the billing worker logs now. If someone can pause client exports for batch 7, do it. I'll tail the worker logs and check transaction trace.

maya: please don't void anything yet — need accounting approval first. @henry can you review?

henry: ok i'll take a look. can you paste the SQL that shows the two invoices and their line items?

liam: SQL snippet: ```SELECT id, amount_cents, line_items FROM invoices WHERE customer_id='cust_9982' AND created_at > '2026-03-23';```
Result pasted:
- inv_224501A | 1367900 | [{service: usage, amount: 1200000}, {support: partner_10pct, amount: 16900}]
- inv_224501B | 1234500 | [{service: usage, amount: 1200000}]

anita: logs show worker path `attach_line_items()` returned 500 on first attempt then retried. On retry the support line upsert didn't run because the job_run_id guard allowed a second execution to skip attaching support. Stack: billing_worker.py:134 -> db/upsert_line.py:78. Non-idempotent upsert + missing unique constraint.

maya: client already messaged support asking why invoice is less. We need to void dup and reissue corrected invoice. Also confirm whether the retry doubled invoice count for this customer or globally.

henry: provisional: void the duplicate inv_224501B and reissue corrected invoice inv_224501C. Amount under legal threshold so manual void ok. Need to document reason in notes and audit trail.

liam: ops, can we blacklist the retry route for cust_9982 for now to avoid another duplicate? @ops

ops: paused invoice_exporter for batch 7 and flagged customer in export blacklist. Created ENG-BILL-919 to track. ETA for fix depends on code review; will keep exporter paused until hotfix.

anita: quick patch plan: make attach_line_items idempotent and add a unique constraint on (job_run_id, customer_id, support_code). I'll open PR and run tests. Also adding retry backoff so we don't spur duplicates.

maya: approvals — Henry approved void. @legal not needed. Who will send the client note? I can draft the message.

maya: draft to Neptune Health: "Hi — we found a billing issue where a support line didn't attach and an automated retry created a second invoice. We'll void the duplicate (inv_224501B) and reissue a corrected invoice today. No action needed on your side. Apologies for the confusion."

henry: include both invoice ids and the support ticket link. I'll sign off once that's in. Also note whether payment was captured.

liam: quick check: payment_gateway shows inv_224501B captured = false, so no refund required. If captured, we'd issue a credit.

maya: good. liam — please include support ticket link in the void note and set note = "dup created by retry 2245016789; see SPT-1456" when voiding.

liam: running update: ```UPDATE invoices SET status='voided', note='dup created by retry 2245016789; see SPT-1456' WHERE id='inv_224501B';``` Will apply after close-of-business if no objections.

anita: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/billing/pull/428 — fixes idempotency, adds unique constraint, and test coverage for retry paths. Scheduling hotfix to staging in 30m, prod after +1 when green.

billing-bot: scheduled job rerun suppressed for cust_9982 until patch deployed.

maya: thanks everyone. tagging this thread for month-end audit follow-up and adding note to the customer's billing history. :thumbsup:
